stat.title: Sites
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(s.id) as cnt from Site as s left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id left outer join State as st on g.stateId = st.id left outer join Lga as l on g.lgaId = l.id

stat.title: Devices
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(d.id) as cnt from Device as d inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join DeviceType as dt on dt.id = d.deviceTypeId inner join DeviceTypeCategory as dc on dc.id = dt.deviceTypeCategoryId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where dc.hasResults = 1

stat.title: Results
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on p.id = s.partnerId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.days = 30

stat.title: Contacts
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(u.id) as cnt from User as u

stat.title: Confirmed cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive'
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive' and r.`createdOn` >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

stat.title: Active cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))), 0) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ResultFollowUp rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp fu ON fu.`id` = rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN FollowUpType ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` = ft.id WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND rfu.resultId = r.id)
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))), 0) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive' AND r.`createdOn` >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ResultFollowUp rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp fu ON fu.`id` = rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN FollowUpType ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` = ft.id WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND rfu.resultId = r.id)

stat.title: Recovered cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))) AS cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND fu.externalId = 'Recovered'
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))) AS cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND fu.externalId = 'Recovered' and rfu.createdOn >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

stat.title: Deaths
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))) AS cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE fu.externalId = 'Died'
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CONCAT('caseId',r.caseId),r.patientData->"$.id", r.externalId,CONCAT('resultId',r.id))) AS cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE fu.externalId = 'Died' and rfu.createdOn >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
